name: the_one_take_scroll
conceit: One continuous scroll, its abstract (never legible) script-texture columns running above a thin frieze that itself carries the story (a chariot halting, Philip approaching, the scroll dissolving into a painted image) -- reading-in-motion without ever cutting away from the scroll itself. This concept flagged twice: both _01 and _02 drifted from hand-inked frieze toward a photographed-museum-artifact look on retry, and the ORIGINAL _01 baked a legible-looking museum placard/label into the frame -- a real no_baked_text guardrail violation caught after the fact, not before.

anti: a beat needing a hard punctuated cut for a big reveal -- this device's whole point is continuous unbroken motion along one scroll, it cannot deliver a crash-cut
any beat where legible text risk is already elevated (ancient-document/manuscript subjects) without an extra-strict lettering guardrail pass

plate_bill.must_contain: long horizontal scroll partially unrolled, dense abstract vertical script-texture (no legible letterforms), a thin ink frieze along the bottom margin: a two-wheeled chariot with two robed figures mid-journey
close view of the scroll's bottom-margin frieze: the chariot halted, one seated figure gesturing mid-question, a second figure approaching on foot from the roadside

the scroll's script-texture columns thinning and dissolving into open parchment on the left, giving way on the right to a soft painted devotional scene: a plain wooden cross silhouette against a pale sky

motion_slots.earned_by: until the baked-text and photoreal-drift issues in _01/_02 are fixed and re-verified clean, no motion budget should be spent animating this concept's current stills.

risk_flags: illustration_lock -- _01 and _02 both drifted photoreal-museum-artifact on retry, worse than the double_entry drift

no_baked_text -- SEVERE: the original _01 render baked a legible English museum placard/label into the frame despite the prompt's own explicit no-legible-text guardrail; treat this concept as unsafe to regenerate without an additional, stricter lettering-suppression pass and a full re-audit before reuse

beat_template.hook: the scroll unrolling, an ink frieze of a chariot mid-journey beneath abstract script
beat_template.pivot: the chariot halts, a figure approaches on foot to meet it
beat_template.landing: the scroll's script dissolves past its own text into a painted cross

score_shape: a steady unrolling forward pulse under the scroll-hook, a small held pause as the chariot halts and the figure approaches, dissolving into a single sustained open chord as the frieze gives way to the cross.
